title: Spectral Inconsistency Entropy: Distinguishing Local from Systemic Contradictions in Pairwise Comparison Graphs
description: Scale- and potential-invariant Spectral Inconsistency Entropy (H) over the cycle-restricted 1-up-Laplacian for pairwise comparison graphs, including the universal Eckmann degeneracy proof on K_n, exact Dirichlet-Digamma isotropic asymptote, and cycle-leverage single-fault localization.
